purpose: Source-reuse (二开 from source) entry ladder for Phase 2. The front half (SOURCE_INTAKE -> REFERENCES_GATHERED -> CAPABILITY_MAPPED -> IMPLEMENTED) is source-specific: a user states a need, the agent finds like-kind open-source references, learns their approach (never bulk-merging a repo), and implements it in the user's own project. From CUSTOMIZATION_RECORDED on it MERGES INTO the shared downstream, reusing the exact same states, requirement kinds and validator engine as the EXE track (no second copy of the downstream truth -- the gate suite's SL-parity test asserts the shared-downstream requires here stay byte-for-byte equal to lifecycle-states.json).
settled_rule: A scaffold field counts as settled when it is present and is not PENDING, UNVERIFIED, UNKNOWN, DISCOVERY_PENDING, TBD or empty. Any value the agent deliberately writes -- including not_applicable -- counts as a decision.
